# Shambhave Wellness

> Shambhave Wellness is a clinical psychology practice in Gurugram, Haryana, India, founded and led by Dr. Amita Puri, Clinical Psychologist. It offers in-person sessions in Gurugram and online therapy for clients in India and abroad, with a focus on narcissistic abuse recovery, trauma, relationships and anxiety.

Expert clinical psychologist in Gurgaon offering online counselling, therapy, hypnotherapy, trauma recovery, and mental health services across India.

## Key facts

- Location: Orchid Petals, Sector 49, Gurugram, Haryana 122018, India
- Phone: +919315311334
- Email: info@shambhavewellness.org
- Languages: English, Hindi

## Courses and training

- [Psychodiagnosis Masterclass in Clinical Assessment](https://www.shambhavewellness.org/course/psychodiagnosis-the-masterclass-in-clinical-assessment): Master psychological assessment techniques, diagnostic frameworks, case formulation, and clinical evaluation skills with expert-led training by Shambhave Wellness.
- [Dark Psychology & Behavioral Manipulation Course](https://www.shambhavewellness.org/course/dark-psychology-behavioral-manipulation): Learn the psychology of influence, manipulation tactics, persuasion techniques, and behavioral patterns through advanced psychological study from Shambhave Wellness.
- [Advanced Clinical Study of Personality Disorders](https://www.shambhavewellness.org/course/personality-disorders-advanced-clinical-study): Gain in-depth knowledge of personality disorders, diagnosis, treatment approaches, and clinical case management strategies at Shambhave Wellness.
- [Clinical Hypnotherapy Certification Training Course](https://www.shambhavewellness.org/course/clinical-hypnotherapy-certification): Become a certified hypnotherapist and learn subconscious mind techniques, hypnosis protocols, and therapeutic intervention methods from Shambhave Wellness.
- [Regression Therapy Certification | Inner Child Healing](https://www.shambhavewellness.org/course/regression-therapy-inner-child-past-life): Learn regression therapy techniques for inner child healing, emotional release, past life exploration, and personal transformation from Shambhave Wellness.
- [SEHT Certification | Subconscious Energy Healing](https://www.shambhavewellness.org/course/seht-subconscious-energy-healing-therapy): Master Subconscious Energy Healing Therapy (SEHT) techniques to help clients overcome emotional blocks and achieve holistic wellness at Shambhave Wellness.
- [Advanced Energy Healing & Chakra Science Course](https://www.shambhavewellness.org/course/advanced-energy-healing-chakra-science): Explore chakra systems, energy healing methods, vibrational wellness, and holistic therapeutic practices through advanced training at Shambhave Wellness.
- [Psycho Astro Therapy (PAT) Certification Course](https://www.shambhavewellness.org/course/psycho-astro-therapy-pat-certification): Learn Psycho Astro Therapy techniques at Shambhave Wellness that integrate psychological insights and astrological principles for holistic guidance.
